reviews.x: I tried to like it.  Good shipping speed, good price, packaged well.  But it doesn't smell like sandalwood to me, not even a tiny bit.  It smells very synthetic and just not good; too sickeningly sweet.  Sigh.  Also, I would like to mention that when it arrived the roller ball was broken - stuck inside the cap.  FYI - it is not returnable, to anyone thinking about ordering this.  I've emailed the seller to ask how they will make this right and am currently awaiting reply.

I bought my first two Auric Blends perfumes two years ago and was very pleased. I bought another two last summer and two more just recently. The scents are lovely and I wish I could describe them in detail, but the last four perfumes I bought are more diluted each time and I can't pick up on the depth of the fragrances. I even wrote an email to Auric Blends politely voicing concern. I understand perfume ingredients must be expensive, but "watering down" perfumes with carrier oil to make

Didn't mean to give it 4 stars, can't change it.  I'm glad this didn't cost much with free shipping. This smells sort of like Love's Baby Soft, basically just baby powder with a hint of sandalwood. Too childish for my taste.

reviews.t: Best sandalwood EVER I got the solid perfume in sandalwood ...
reviews.x: Best sandalwood EVER I got the solid perfume in sandalwood from a vendor at a native american pow-wow near me years ago and it was my favorite sent in the world, but it never lasted very long on my skin. I am STOKED to find this in liquid form!! I can't stop smelling my arm. If you love woodsy scents you will love this! Totally unisex. Can't recommend enough!

reviews.t: Amazingly Potent, Great for Candlemaking, Epicly Priced.
reviews.x: Incredibly aromatic, strong, I use it for candlemaking and it works very well. It's very potent and claimed to be "pure" which I can believe by how strong it is. I tend to mix this with other scents they offer, being 8.50 for this size is an amazing deal when a company like Kumba which has equal scents, in my opinion, costs nearly 2-3 times as much. They also on their website offer trial samples.
I love Auric Blends. I own numerous scents by this line, and I love the smell of sandalwood,  but for some reason I just wasn't feeling it with this one.
We use this oil to blend with a couple of other scents for something custom. You really can't do this with just any oil. This stuff is great!
This is a light scent that has a very nice soft smell. Best sandalwood scent out there and very good price

reviews.t: This literally just smells like baby powder
reviews.x: This literally just smells like baby powder. I read all these reviews about how it was so musky and sexy and I was so jazzed to buy it and then I smelled like someone had just changed my diaper. I couldn't wait to shower so I could get that smell off me. All day, I kept thinking there were babies around me, and I don't even like babies, so it was no fun. It's not a terrible smell, don't get me wrong. In fact, it's perfectly pleasant. But if I wanted to smell like baby powder, I'd just wear baby

reviews.t: Scent is one of my favorites in my later years.
reviews.x: I love the subtle scent.  My other favorite scent is Mitsuko which is an old Scent, also subtle & mossy.  I find scents on older women are often too strong, I think because, they lose their ability to smell the strong scents.  The Sandlewood is rolling and I can control the amount of the scent and thus avoid offending anyone particularly myself.

Can't remember how long ago I bought my first bottles maybe 20+ years ago. Oil lasts a long time on your skin and  bottles also last a long time. Great for travelling.  Over the years with 2 different scents I've noticed the batches are slightly different likely due to the differences in the plant oils.

reviews.t: I don't like perfumes, so this is perfect for me
reviews.x: I don't like perfumes, so this is perfect for me!  It smells subtle and delicious without being harsh and artificial like most perfumes are.  It lasts for hours and I get compliments all the time.  I bought Sandalwood, which is actually a blend of several oils and not true sandalwood.

I have another sandalwood roll on that i purchased at a store out of state. I have loved it so much and am almost out. Ordered this as a replacement. This one smells more of baby powder than sandalwood. Very disappointed.

reviews.t: I ordered the Sandalwood scent and it definitely smells like baby powder even after it dries down
reviews.x: I ordered the Sandalwood scent and it definitely smells like baby powder even after it dries down... Specifically it smells like the "Baby Soft" perfume you can find for $3 at Wal-Mart.
Should have listened to the reviewers who said this smells like baby powder and nothing like sandalwood.  Won't be buying this again.

reviews.t: I had such high hopes for quality.  This oil didn't smell anything LIKE sandalwood.
reviews.x: This oil didn't smell anything LIKE sandalwood.  it smelled okay, but it wasn't the true sandalwood fragrance I was looking for.
Smells like powder not so much sandalwood but not a horrible smell. Still wear it but wanted sandalwood. Disappointed.

reviews.t: fine but wouldn't order a 2nd time
reviews.x: this fragrance oil was purchased for my husband--we were HOPING for SANDALWOOD scent--this is awfully powdery smelling--it's nice, don't get me wrong, but it's only a HINT of sandalwood in the fragrance. I'm feeling really silly for having ordered 2. my husband does say that he likes it and he is wearing it and it mixes fine with his body chemistry, but still not what we were hoping for.  next time I'll order from a local company or just go to a retail store--that way I smell the oil for myself-

I purchased the 'Sandalwood' roll-on fragrance, and was sent 'Aphrodesia' instead, which the seller corrected by sending me the correct item. I can barely tell the difference between the two scents though. They smell almost identical, and very Johnson & Johnson baby oil like to me. I wonder if that's what they're using as a base for the scents. My nose is extremely sensitive, so I had a few other people close their eyes and smell each fragrance. Everyone came to the same conclusion. Needless to

I believe I am a conisuer of sandalwood.  When my local health market closed I was lucky to be able to purchase the brand here. Unlike some other oils this oil stays with me, It's not sticky overwhelming and is just a sweet, woodsy, exotic scent that is spectacular for me.  I also have ventured into purchasing other fragrances by Auric and they are just as good.  If you like natural oil scents..this brand is for you. I would take this over a high end perfume any day.

reviews.t: but it smells somewhat like baby powder and I'm not a fan of that ...
reviews.x: It was shipped really fast and it was as described.  I gave it to my friend because (in my opinion) it can be worn by either sex.  It may just be my sense of smell, but it smells somewhat like baby powder and I'm not a fan of that smell (I DO like babies, just not baby powder smell), so I gave it to him and he likes it a lot.

I'm not sure how I feel about this scent.  It's nice enough, it lasts and my husband absolutely loves it!  I like it well enough but it doesn't smell much like sandalwood to me.  *shrug*  Then again, I've never smelled REAL sandal wood, only sandalwood scented products so maybe my idea of what it smells like is a bit off.

This sandalwood is actually a blend that hints at being sandalwood. However, what ever it is blended with is very overpowering and floral. I had ordered this same thing several years ago and back then it smelled more like sandalwood. If you are looking for a true sandalwood scent. Skip this and look else where.

I have been using this product for years and I am happy with the scent but not an expert on sandlewood.  I expected a roller bottle as is advertized and what I have always recieved but recieved it in new packaging and no roller bottle.

This smells not even remotely close to sandalwood. I have been wearing sandalwood for years and recently have not been able to find it anywhere locally, but I struck out by purchasing this. Well, the search continues....

claims.text: Many reviewers say the scent smells like baby powder rather than sandalwood.
Several reviewers praise it as a great sandalwood scent or favorite perfume.
Reviewers frequently mention the good price and value.
Some reviewers find the scent weak or diluted, while others find it potent and long-lasting.
A few reviewers note batch variation or a broken roller ball on arrival.
